title: 我走丢了
subtitle: 别怕，我知道该怎么做
character: wearing a green hoodie, beige trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, loose simple pen and ink line drawing with soft flat watercolor washes, few details, warm friendly colors, clean simple shapes, signs and shelves without any writing
facts: 走丢了先停下来，爸爸妈妈会回来找
穿制服的工作人员、警察，或带小朋友的阿姨
背熟爸爸妈妈的电话号码
不跟不认识的人离开这里

pages.zh:
周末，妈妈带我去超市买东西。
超市好大好大，一排一排的货架，比我还要高。
妈妈推着购物车，对我说：
「人多的地方，要牵好我的手哦。」
我点点头，拉住了妈妈的手。
pages.scene: The little boy holds his mother's hand as they walk into a big bright supermarket with tall shelves, the mother is a grown adult woman with short hair in a blue coat pushing a shopping cart.

pages.zh:
走着走着，我看见了一整排玩具，
小汽车、积木、恐龙……好多好多！
我一高兴，就松开了妈妈的手，
一个人跑了过去，
把妈妈说的话忘得干干净净。
pages.scene: The little boy runs happily down a supermarket aisle toward shelves full of colorful toys, his arms swinging.

pages.zh:
我玩了一会儿，回头一看——
妈妈不见了！
到处都是不认识的人，推着车走来走去。
我的心咚咚咚地跳，眼泪都快要掉下来了。
妈妈，你在哪里呀？
pages.scene: The little boy stands alone in a supermarket aisle looking around with a worried face, tall shelves on both sides, blurry shoppers far away in the background.

pages.zh:
我想起妈妈教过我的：
走丢了，先站在原地，不要乱跑，
也不要跟不认识的人走。
妈妈发现我不见了，一定会回来找我。
我深深吸了一口气，站好，不哭了。
pages.scene: The little boy stands still at the end of a supermarket shelf, taking a deep breath with his hands at his sides, a calm and brave face.

pages.zh:
等了一会儿，妈妈还没来，我可以找谁帮忙呢？
妈妈说过，要找穿着制服、戴着工牌的「工作人员」，
比如超市收银台的阿姨；
或者找带着小朋友的阿姨。
她们都会帮我找到妈妈。
pages.scene: A friendly woman supermarket cashier with short black hair in a green uniform apron with a name badge stands smiling at a checkout counter, and nearby a mother holds her small daughter's hand, a bright simple supermarket behind them.

pages.zh:
我走到收银台前。
收银员阿姨从柜台后面走出来，弯下腰看着我。
我说：「阿姨，我找不到妈妈了。」
阿姨的声音软软的：
「别怕，阿姨帮你一起找。」
pages.scene: At the supermarket checkout the kind cashier woman in a green uniform apron has stepped out from behind the counter and bends down to the little boy's eye level, her hands resting on her knees, listening to him with a gentle face while he talks to her.

pages.zh:
阿姨问我叫什么名字，
我大声说出了自己的名字，
还一个数字一个数字，背出了妈妈的电话号码。
阿姨马上拿起电话：
「好的，我们这就请妈妈过来。」
pages.scene: At the checkout counter the kind cashier holds a telephone to her ear while the little boy stands beside her speaking clearly and pointing to himself.

pages.zh:
超市里的喇叭响了：
「请穿绿色卫衣的小朋友的妈妈，
听到广播后到收银台来，您的孩子在这里等您。」
好多人都抬起头来听，
妈妈也一定听见了！
pages.scene: A loudspeaker on the ceiling of a big supermarket with soft sound waves drawn coming out of it, shoppers below looking up and listening.

pages.zh:
没过一会儿，妈妈急急忙忙跑了过来，
一把把我抱进怀里，抱得紧紧的。
「宝贝，妈妈好担心你！
你站着没乱跑，还找了工作人员，做得真好！」
我也紧紧地抱着妈妈。
pages.scene: The mother in her blue coat kneels down by the checkout and hugs the little boy tightly, both relieved and happy, the kind cashier smiling behind them.

pages.zh:
回家的路上，太阳红红的，
我把妈妈的手牵得紧紧的。
我记住了三件事：
走丢了先站着不动，找穿制服的工作人员，
说出自己的名字和妈妈的电话号码。
pages.scene: The little boy and his mother, a grown adult woman with short black hair in a blue coat, walk home hand in hand along a tree-lined street at sunset, the mother carrying a shopping bag, both smiling.
